title: FoxPack
description: A orange Hotbar, Inventory and Buttons Texture Pack!
body:
A FoxPVP inspired Orange Hotbar and Inventory Texture Pack to have more fun at fighting and pvping!
All Changes:

• Orange Hotbar                               
• Rounded and Orange Buttons                               
• Orange Inventory                                                              
• Other Orange Small Things                               

❗This Texture Pack does not include PVP Changes like small Totem Pop, no explosion particles or more.
Please use the **[RommelPVP Texture Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/rommelpvp)** to also have Vanilla PVP ❗
